title.romaji: Pocket Monsters Black 2 White 2: Introduction Special Movie
title.english: Pokémon Black 2 White 2: Introduction Special Movie

Media.description: Promotional short for the Pokémon Black 2 and White 2 video games.

node.description: As with both the Advanced Generation and Diamond & Pearl series before it, the Best Wishes! series begins with only Ash Ketchum, headed off to the Unova region, located far away from Kanto, Johto, Hoenn and Sinnoh, with his Pikachu. After he meets up with the new trainer and rival Trip and the region's Professor Juniper, he gains traveling companions in Iris, a girl from a town known for its Dragon Pokémon, and Cilan, Pokémon Connoisseur and the Grass Pokémon specialist of the three Straition City Gym Leaders.

title.romaji: Pocket Monsters Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire: Mega Special Animation
title.english: Pokémon Omega Ruby and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire Animated Trailer

mediaRecommendation.description:
The Pokémon Company streamed the "Mega Special Animation" short inspired by the upcoming Pokémon Omega Ruby and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire games on Sunday. The short features Pokémon undergoing the newly discovered Mega Evolution and Primal Reversion in the Hoenn region.

(Source: Anime News Network)
